text:
Maria Chen: Morning — alert: multiple inference pods stuck Pending in eu-west-1, CA couldn't provision matching GPU instances.
Alex K: saw ~07:04 spike. CA logs: "no nodes are available that match the requested resources" and "node group is full" for our gpu pools.
Shiv Patel: this is the tf-managed nodegroup (gpu-dedicated-eu). We switched to a mixed-instance policy + spot last month, might be tripping matching logic.
Maria Chen: current TF uses min=2 max=8. CA has defaults. I think CA can't expand because of instance type constraints in the nodegroup resource limits.
Ryan T: quick mitigation: create a tiny on-demand fallback pool (1-2 nodes) with p3-equivalent hardware, tainted so only critical inference schedules there.
Ellen R: agree but cost hit. Alternative is to increase max_size by 2-4 as a temporary buffer — need cloud quota check first.
Alex K: operational flags that help: set cluster-autoscaler args: --balance-similar-node-groups, --expander=least-waste, --max-node-provision-time=15m. Also enable multiple instance types in ASG.
Shiv Patel: TF prototype for fallback pool (sketch):

resource "aws_autoscaling_group" "gpu_fallback" {
  name = "gpu-fallback-eu"
  min_size = 1
  max_size = 3
  mixed_instances_policy { ... }
  tags = [{key = "k8s.io/cluster-autcaler/enabled", value = "true"}, {key = "k8s.io/cluster-autoscaler/gpu-fallback", value = "owned"}]
}

module "node_labeler" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@repo/infra-modules.git//k8s/node-labeler"
  labels = { pool = "gpu-fallback" }
}

Maria Chen: we'll taint nodes with gpu=fallback:NoSchedule and label pool=fallback-gpu. Critical workloads must have toleration + nodeSelector.
Alex K: recommend a mutating admission hook to auto-inject tolerations/nodeSelector for jobs with label workload=inference-critical so devs don't forget.
Ryan T: also check kubelet eviction thresholds on GPU nodes: noisy preempts can cause pods to bounce; bump evictionHard for memory/cpu on GPU nodes.
Ellen R: Helm values for CA I'm proposing:

extraArgs:
  balance-similar-node-groups: "true"
  expander: "least-waste"
  max-node-provision-time: "15m"
  scan-interval: "10s"

Shiv Patel: one more: set ASG tags that allow CA to pick multiple instance types and ensure launch template allows overriding. Otherwise CA treats nodegroup as single-type.
Maria Chen: good call. I'll open a PR with: 1) add fallback nodepool TF, 2) bump max_size to 10, 3) update CA helm args, 4) add admission webhook RFC.
infra-bot: [aws-autoscaler] 2025-11-09T07:06:12Z - ClusterAutoscaler: NodeGroup gpu-dedicated-eu has no suitable instances available in requested zone. Suggest: add zone-capable types or increase maxSize.
Alex K: also watch podAntiAffinity and small CPU-only sidecars that block binpacking. We should audit pod specs to avoid unnecessary anti-affinity on latency-critical jobs.
Maria Chen: noted. I'll add a short checklist for inference teams: set workload=latency-critical, include toleration, minimize anti-affinity rules.
Ellen R: I'll review the PR. If green, let's run on staging for 1h then deploy to prod and keep CA debug logs on for 24h.
Shiv Patel: I'll follow up on quota request for p3/p4 capacity with cloud ops if we still see failures after changes.
Maria Chen: thanks all — action items assigned in PR. We'll monitor Pending pods and CA events closely after deploy. :rocket:
